description: Living dependency map of the enforce-mode Claude Code plugin. Nodes are logical components; edges are grounded in actual require()/file-read-write/installer-copy lines. Source of truth — keep in sync with code (see dependency-map.md for the human view).

contracts.state-json: Per-session JSON at getStatePath(sessionId) under ~/.claude; read/written by enforce-state.js. Carries PECK ticks, compliance, ground-truth, GTC.
contracts.flag-file: ~/.claude/.enforce-active (plain level string). Writers: activation, level-switch, mode-tracker, config. Reader: statusline.
contracts.rules-manifest: ~/.claude/.enforce-rules-manifest. Written by installers, read by uninstall to remove the exact domain-rule set.

couplingLegend.hard: breaks on change of the target
couplingLegend.soft: try-guarded / degrades but does not crash

nodes.operations: Core session state read/write (PECK ticks, compliance, ground-truth, GTC compute/format/record); atomic temp+rename.
Resolve default level (env > config.json > settings.json); write flag-file.
Scan project manifests (package.json/requirements/go.mod/...) → domain list; single readdirSync.
buildContext(): read rule .md files, compress, assemble injected context.
Detect/read enforce-anchor markers in project CLAUDE.md.
Extract API symbols, ground against researched libs; BUILTIN_METHODS table.
SessionStart: resolve level, build+inject rules, write flag, ensure statusline.
UserPromptSubmit: inject static enforce reminder (orient-before-building, plan-first, routing, critique gate, fail-loud, living-docs, task-loop). No internal require/fs.
nodes.note: Code-isolated; coupled only via hook registration. Content mirrors universal.md (references, does not restate).

nodes.operations: UserPromptSubmit: parse /enforce command → setLevel + write flag.
UserPromptSubmit: sync level → state + flag.
PreToolUse Write|Edit / Bash: PECK advisory checks, grounding gate.
Stop: unresolved/test gate summary, compute+record GTC score, read transcript.
GTC (ground-truth-confidence) scoring; logic in state-store, surfaced by stop-completion.
statusLine command renders level badge from flag; setup writes scripts + settings.
SessionStart: warn if CLAUDE.md/architecture.md/progress.md missing.
SessionStart: warn if dependency-map.json/.md missing; emit contract guidance.

Layer-1 constraint intake gate (ADVISORY). SessionStart: warn if constraints.json missing. PreToolUse Write|Edit: on implementation code with no captured production constraints, inject a strong advisory + record pending. Never blocks.

dependsOn.contract: defensive require('./enforce-state') for isActive/isExempt/recordPending/logEvent; degrades to no-op if absent

nodes.operations: Copy hooks/*.js + rules/*.md + SKILL.md to ~/.claude; wire settings.json hooks + statusLine; write rules-manifest.
Remove flag, sessions, config, enforce-*.js hooks, manifest-listed domain rules, settings entries.
Save/resume/append session state to ~/.claude session dir + log.
nodes.status: ORPHANED: not copied by either installer

nodes.operations: Discover/resolve skills, load on write/research transcript triggers, cache.
nodes.status: PARTIAL: only SKILL.md copied by installers; the .js trio is orphaned

nodes.operations: Domain/DSA/post-write PECK checks + ground-truth capture.
nodes.status: ORPHANED: not copied/wired by installer or plugin.json

nodes.operations: .js = per-domain pattern tables consumed by domain-guard; .md = injected rule text copied to ~/.claude.
nodes.note: installer copies the .md half only; the .js half is consumed only by the orphaned domain-guard.

nodes.operations: Department subagent definitions realizing the CLAUDE.md routing map; each carries Domain DSA + enforce contract.

dependsOn.contract: agents reference universal.md + rules/mechanisms.md by name (loaded as global rules, not a code edge)

nodes.note: Not copied by hooks/install.*; delivered via plugin marketplace. No code edge.

nodes.operations: Plugin-mode hook registration: UserPromptSubmit(level-switch,prompt-append), SessionStart(activate,project-docs,dependency-map), PreToolUse Write|Edit(write-guard), Stop(stop-guard).

findings.title: Broken installer edges
findings.detail: grounding + anchor are require()d by copied/wired hooks (enforce-activate.js:24, enforce-write-guard.js:25) but absent from both install.sh and install.ps1 copy lists. Installed enforce-activate.js throws on require('./enforce-anchor').

findings.title: Orphaned hooks (installed-form)
findings.detail: advisory-guards-unwired (domain-guard, dsa-guard, post-write-check, research-capture), the skills .js trio, and session-snapshot trio have real require edges but no entry point loads them after install (not in installer copy list nor plugin.json).

findings.title: Copied-but-dead
findings.detail: enforce-research-gate.js, enforce-test-gate.js, enforce-pre-completion.js are copied by both installers but have zero inbound require edges and are not wired as hooks.

findings.title: Plugin vs installer drift
findings.detail: plugin.json wires 7 hooks; installers wire 9 (add mode-tracker, bash-guard). Divergent registration surfaces.
